# Structure

## Purpose

- Use PowerPoint when downstream editing is required.
- Prefer conventional slide structures.
- Reserve Reveal.js-specific classes for browser presentations.

# Handover

## Before sharing

1. Open the `.pptx` in PowerPoint.
2. Confirm fonts and image placement.
3. Add alt text where PowerPoint did not preserve it.
4. Run the accessibility checker.

## Source and automatic elements

The [source of this PowerPoint example](https://github.com/PHBern-RConrardy/phbern-is1/blob/main/examples/powerpoint.qmd)
uses ordinary headings, lists, and Quarto columns. The PHBern PowerPoint
layouts come from the bundled `reference.pptx`; Reveal.js classes do not carry
over to editable PowerPoint slides.
